name: Project-Management-Web-App
description: A project management tool featuring a Python/FastAPI backend and a Next.js frontend. The application includes CRUD operations for projects and tasks , role-based user management , and a bonus AI feature for generating user stories using the GROQ API.

name: LinkedOut
description: LinkedOut is an employee-first career platform that challenges traditional hiring by helping professionals discover, evaluate, and review companies through transparent workplace insights. Built with a production-grade monorepo architecture using Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and modern cloud-native tooling.

name: setbeat
description: SetBeat: a gesture-driven gym timer for Android that rides your music. Now-playing companion with a beat-reactive waveform. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Media3. No internet, no accounts.

name: hospital-management-system
description: JDBC-based Hospital Management System with DAO architecture and MySQL integration.

name: QueryCraft-AI
description: ⚡ QueryCraft: An AI-powered database assistant. Chat with your data in plain English to generate, explain, and execute SQL and NoSQL queries instantly.

name: Custom-Language-Translator
description: A customizable Neural Machine Translation (NMT) pipeline built with TensorFlow and Keras. Supports TSV datasets, preprocessing, training with Seq2Seq + attention, beam search inference, and an interactive Gradio web app. Includes tokenizer handling, checkpoints, and flexible deployment for multilingual translation.
